close_below_mm.source: N3 placeholder: close/slim shirt upper bound, ~12 cm chest ease. Drafting-convention range, not verified.

regular_below_mm.source: N3 placeholder: regular shirt upper bound, ~18 cm chest ease. Drafting-convention range, not verified.

relaxed_below_mm.source: N3 placeholder: relaxed shirt upper bound, ~25 cm chest ease. Not verified.

uncertainty_mm.source: N3 placeholder: three times the woven value because jersey stretch recovery and the tension the flat width was measured under are not controlled (blueprint section 7: wider uncertainty for jersey). No study cited.
